stats.description: the reader stats substances change (`testo`, `appetite`): baseline + half-life, ITEMS.md "Substances"

albums.description: the music media items carry (albums.ts), language-neutral

Catalog.description: The item catalog. `accepted_warnings` (here and on items / albums) are the admin's accepted catalog warnings (catalogWarningPlace): stored with the entries – a list-wide one in the meta entry `items` – never served to readers.

takeable.description: a story may take it from the reader (VN `takeItem` / a choice's `take`; owner 2026-10-07, BACKLOG 10.38) – never a physical item; off by default

wear.description: Wardrobe overlays of a wearable (ITEMS.md "Wardrobe"): `<character>` or `<character>/<slot instance id>` → CDN path of a full-body overlay aligned to that character's A-pose (768 × 1152, transparent WebP, convention `characters/<character>/wear/<item>[-<slot instance>].webp`). A body without an overlay draws the item's icon at the slot anchor instead.

default_worn.description: Part of the basic dress (ITEMS.md "Wardrobe": T-shirt, shorts, sandals): a starter wearable that is put on when it is handed out (signup, older accounts, guests). A body without an overlay for it wears another starter of the same slot that has one instead (the swim pants on yellowmouse / Top Toy) – `basicDress`.

respawn.description: When a picked-up placement of this item is back on its slice (respawn.ts): a default interval and the range a placement may choose; none / null = it never reappears (a one-time find). Admin → Catalog can override it.

effects.description: a substance's stat changes (`catalog.stats` ids), ITEMS.md "Substances"

max.description: Collection limit: at most this many per account (owner 2026-10-02); none = `MAX_PER_ACCOUNT` (99). Rarer items set less. The server refuses more (409 max_reached); a claimed physical product (QR code) is always added.

giftable.description: Can a reader gift it to another reader (ITEMS.md "Ownership, claims, gifting")? None = yes, except starters / the basic dress and membership / access-only items (`isGiftable`). The server decides (403 not_giftable).

album.description: A media item's album (`catalog.albums` id) and its sound carrier (agents/ITEMS.md "Players, albums, related items"): it plays in the app only for a reader who owns a player of that format.

plays.description: A player: the formats it plays (`record_player` → `['vinyl']`)

ItemCategory.description: `food` = eaten with the `apply` skill ("Essen" instead of "Benutzen"), e.g. the cucumber and the tuna can lower appetite

labels.description: ImageNet class words that count as a hit (MobileNet on the device)

per_day.description: at most this many scan grants of `grants` per account in 24 h (server: 429 daily_limit); none = no daily limit

name.description: what the camera says it recognised for `labels` ("Pillendose"); none = the matched model label

map.description: More things to find (the multi-label Check It camera, ITEMS.md "Substances"): recognised labels → the item they grant, checked together with `labels` → `grants` (the best match wins) – `scanTargets` / `matchScan`.

PlayAudioSkill.deprecated:
(2026-10-02) the music belongs to an album now: a media item has `album` + `format` and plays only with a
player (`plays`), albums.ts. Still read gracefully (`legacyPlayAudio`): plays without a player.

ApplySkill.description: "Benutzen" applies a substance ("Essen" for `food`): one piece is used up, its `effects` / `effect` hit the reader (substances.ts)

ItemRespawn.description: An item's respawn rule (`ItemDef.respawn`; none / null = it never reappears, a one-time find). `min` / `max` = the shortest / longest interval a placement may choose (default: only `default`'s own length … any longer one). The intervals and their periods are the shared recurrence model (recurrence.ts).

RecurrenceInterval.description: Every page view (`visit`: a new page or a reload starts a new one), or every n minutes / hours / days.

TimedInterval.description: A timed interval: every n minutes / hours / days (n a whole number ≥ 1, at most a year).

delta.description: added to the current (decayed) level, then clamped to 0–100

StatEffect.description: One stat change of a substance.

TimedEffect.description: A temporary reader effect of a substance (e.g. `psychedelic`): active until now + duration.

image.description: the recipe's own picture (CDN path, `<toon>/items/recipes/<id>.webp`; owner 2026-10-04) – none = the output item's

baseline.description: 0–100, the neutral start and where the level drifts back to

half_life_days.description: the distance to the baseline halves every N days

StatDef.description: A reader stat (`catalog.stats.<id>`): where it rests and how fast it gets back there.

toon.description: the toon it belongs to (null = cross-toon)

download.description: CDN-root path of the album download (a zip), if there is one – reachable without a player

cover.description: CDN-root path of a cover image, optional

access.description: who may download / listen (per album: one zip and one track list, whichever of its media items someone owns)

Album.description: An album: the music a media item carries (language-neutral; only the title is text)

title.description: the song's name (proper names are the same in every language)

src.description: CDN-root path of the streamable file (`<toon>/audio/music/<name>.128.mp3`)

download.description: who gets the album download (`download`), default `members` (the toon page's music download as before)

listen.description: who may listen in the app, default `owners`; a player for the format is always needed
